title: SoloDual
description: A modpack that includes the Cobblemon mod along with some other mods that complement the Pokémon mod well. It's optimized for computers with limited RAM to provide a slightly better experience. I hope you like it. I might improve the modpack in the future.
body: A modpack that includes the Cobblemon mod along with some other mods that complement the Pokémon mod well. It's optimized for computers with limited RAM to provide a slightly better experience. I hope you like it. I might improve the modpack in the future. (Just to be clear, I'm not trying to compete. This is just for people with low-end PCs.)
